sentence: This project studies how quantum computing and machine learning can help predict and manage sudden traffic changes on large transportation networks.
This project builds methods that assemble the genome of an organism from read fragments, focusing on repetitive sequences that are hard to assemble.
This project uses a mass spectrometer to study how microbes interact with their hosts, looking at proteins and small molecules.
This project builds ways to protect scientific data and keep trust in workflows that run on shared computer systems.
This project studies the species that live on the deep sea floor and how they are distributed, using environmental DNA and ecological models.
This project builds laser traps that hold rubidium atoms and minimize laser noise, so the atoms can be used for quantum simulation.
This project uses a machine learning model to design composite materials with solid and liquid fillers and to study how they fail under large deformations.
This project builds a laser for bioprinting that places cells to make tissue without a dynamic release layer.
This project studies how climate change affects the biological pump, which carries carbon from the ocean surface to the deep sea, in a polar region.
This project studies how to build fabrics from liquid crystal elastomer fibers that change shape or stiffness on their own in response to heat or light.
This project builds computer models of human decision making based on quantum probability theory and studies how quantum hardware can run them.
This project studies how gases interact with the surfaces of ionic liquid droplets at the nanoscale, using near-field optical methods.
This project grows high-quality crystals of cubic boron arsenide and measures their thermal conductivity.
This project develops online machine learning methods using partial differential equations and tests how well algorithms predict medical data from images of the human body.
This project builds a sensing tool that uses entangled photons to detect vibrations in materials and tests it on a variety of materials.
